assessment.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v oblasti Blízkého východu a námořních tras zůstává kritická kvůli pokračujícím útokům na tankery v Hormuzském průlivu a aktivitám Houthiů. Geopolitické napětí se rozšiřuje i do černomořského regionu, což nadále narušuje globální logistické řetězce.
assessment.security_status_en: The security situation in the Middle East and maritime chokepoints remains critical due to ongoing tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi activities. Geopolitical tensions are also spilling over into the Black Sea region, further disrupting global supply chains.

recommendations.reason_cs: Přetrvávající krize v Hormuzském průlivu a Rudém moři váže kapacity plavidel a udržuje vysoké sazby za přepravu. To se pozitivně odráží v hospodářských výsledcích rejdařství.
recommendations.reason_en: Persistent crises in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea tie up vessel capacity and keep freight rates elevated. This is positively reflected in the financial performance of shipping lines.

recommendations.sector_cs: Obranný průmysl (např. RTX, Lockheed Martin, BAE Systems)
recommendations.sector_en: Defense Industry (e.g. RTX, Lockheed Martin, BAE Systems)
recommendations.reason_cs: Eskalace konfliktů na Blízkém východě a globální doplňování vyčerpaných zbrojních zásob zajišťují stabilní poptávku a zakázky. Obranný sektor těží z vysoké úrovně geopolitického napětí.
recommendations.reason_en: Escalating Middle East conflicts and global replenishment of depleted weapons stockpiles ensure steady demand and order books. The defense sector benefits from high geopolitical tensions.

recommendations.sector_cs: Ropa a Plyn (např. Shell, BP, Chevron)
recommendations.reason_cs: Hrozby přerušení dodávek z Blízkého východu a útoky na energetickou infrastrukturu udržují ceny komodit na zvýšené úrovni. To generuje silné cash flow pro energetické giganty.
recommendations.reason_en: Threats of supply disruptions from the Middle East and attacks on energy infrastructure keep commodity prices elevated. This generates strong cash flow for major energy firms.

recommendations.sector_cs: Evropský Spotřební sektor & Autoprůmysl (např. Volvo, BMW)
recommendations.reason_cs: Firmy čelí vyšším nákladům na delší námořní trasy a nejistotě v dodavatelských řetězcích, ale silná smluvní zajištění pomáhají tlumit okamžité dopady na ziskovost.
recommendations.reason_en: Companies face higher costs from longer shipping routes and supply chain uncertainty, but strong contractual hedging helps cushion the immediate impact on profitability.

recommendations.sector_cs: Pražská burza: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group
recommendations.sector_en: Prague Stock Exchange: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group

recommendations.reason_en: Domestic equities benefit from stable dividends and local demand while remaining partly insulated from direct impacts of Middle East conflicts. The outlook remains neutral.

recommendations.sector_cs: Evropské blue-chips (např. Airbus, TotalEnergies, Allianz, Rheinmetall)
recommendations.sector_en: European blue-chips (e.g. Airbus, TotalEnergies, Allianz, Rheinmetall)
recommendations.reason_cs: Smíšený makroekonomický výhled a geopolitická rizika vyžadují selektivní přístup, přičemž energetické a obranné tituly vyvažují slabší spotřebitelskou poptávku.
recommendations.reason_en: Mixed macroeconomic outlook and geopolitical risks call for a selective approach, with energy and defense stocks balancing out weaker consumer-driven demand.

assessment.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat vysokou volatilitu na energetických trzích a přetrvávající prémii v sazbách za námořní přepravu. Bezpečnostní rizika v klíčových úžinách zůstanou primárním rizikovým faktorem pro globální aktiva.
assessment.forecast_en: High volatility in energy markets and a persistent premium in maritime freight rates can be expected over the coming days. Security risks in key chokepoints will remain a primary risk factor for global assets.
assessment.forecast_review_cs: Předchozí předpověď se plně potvrdila, neboť incidenty v Hormuzském průlivu a přetrvávající rizika nadále pohánějí volatilitu komodit a marže v námořní dopravě.
assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast was fully confirmed, as incidents in the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing risks continue to drive commodity volatility and maritime shipping margins.

articles.title: Iran accuses UN of whitewashing US, Israeli actions
articles.summary:
Iran accuses UN of whitewashing US, Israeli actions

The Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson has slammed the United Nations' human rights mechanism on Iran, accusing it of attempting to "whitewash" US and Israeli actions. 

"Exploiting the so-called Special Rapporteurship on the Situation of Human Rights in Iran to blame Iran for the crimes committed by the US and Israel amounts to nothing less than a deliberate attempt to whitewash aggression, atrocities, and unilateral coercive measures", Esmaeil Baqaei said in a post on X. 

"Such an approach is deeply misleading and profoundly disingenous," he added. 

Regardless of the politically motivated nature of the mandate imposed on the Human Rights Council by the UK، exploiting the so-called Special Rapporteurship on the Situation of Human Rights in Iran to blame Iran for the crimes committed by the US and Israel amounts to nothing less than a deliberate attempt to whitewash aggression, atrocities, and unilateral coercive measures. Such an approach is deeply misleading and profoundly disingenous.

— Esmaeil Baqaei (@IRIMFA_SPOX) October 29, 2026

articles.title: More on tanker set ablaze in Hormuz Strait
articles.summary:
More on tanker set ablaze in Hormuz Strait

A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by a small boat with two explosive devices attached to its hull, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said in an update on Friday.

This caused blasts and sparked a fire in the vessel's engine room that temporarily disabled it. 

According to UKMTO, the crew were safe, there was no environmental impact and the fire had been extinguished. The vessel is now continuing to its next port of call.

There was no immediate answer as to who was behind the attack. 

Earlier, we reported that the tanker, transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz, was on fire. The incident occurred 25 nautical miles north east of Oman's Khasab.

articles.title: US Treasury chief claims Iran 'running out of' economic lifelines
articles.summary:
US Treasury chief claims Iran 'running out of' economic lifelines

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent claimed that Iran is "running out of" economic lifelines amid Washington's sanctions on Tehran. 

"Under Operation Economic Outcast, Iran’s regime is running out of lifelines, and its proxies are feeling the pressure," he said in a post on X. 

He further claimed that the country is "struggling to move money, while the IRGC is reportedly failing to pay its own troops".

"We are cutting the regime’s ability to fund the Houthis, Hamas, and Hizballah. We will not allow Tehran to continue financing their campaign of terror," Bessent added.

Under Operation Economic Outcast, Iran’s regime is running out of lifelines, and its proxies are feeling the pressure. Tehran is struggling to move money, while the IRGC is reportedly failing to pay its own troops. We are cutting the regime’s ability to fund the Houthis, Hamas, and Hizballah. We will not allow Tehran to continue financing their campaign of terror.

— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) October 30, 2026

articles.title: JD Vance letter may offer last chance to avert fresh conflict between US and Iran
articles.summary:
US vice-president writes to top Iranian security official in sign Washington has not abandoned diplomacy

Hopes of averting a major new conflagration between Iran and the US soon after Tuesday’s midterm elections could rest on Iran’s response to a personal letter from the US vice-president, JD Vance, offering to restart diplomacy.

The letter, written after predominantly Qatari mediation, was sent to the secretary of Iran’s supreme national security council, Mohsen Rezaei on Sunday. It requires Tehran to agree to make commitments on its nuclear programme at the start of a process that would lead to the opening of the strait of Hormuz within seven days in return for US sanctions relief.

articles.summary:
Tankers, tracked by Greenpeace, are first phase of Trump-Putin deal – but there is uncertainty over whether they will unload

Seven oil tankers carrying an estimated 288,000 tonnes of Russian diesel are now sailing towards the US, though it is uncertain if the vessels will be able to unload amid a political row about the legality of the shipments.

The transport, tracked by the pressure group Greenpeace, is the first phase of a contentious supply deal negotiated between presidents Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin earlier this month, reversing years of sanctions on Russia oil.
